title: Realtime, Storage & Collaboration
description: Add collaboration without confusing server truth, cache state, realtime events, and storage authorization.

lessons.title: Realtime Event Model
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: Realtime sends change notifications after data changes. The event is a signal that client state may need reconciliation; it should not automatically become a second source of truth. In this course, we connect it directly to realtime collaboration and file-storage behavior across multiple TaskFlow clients, so you can see where the idea lives in a real project instead of memorizing a definition.
objectives: Explain Realtime Event Model in terms of inputs, owner, outputs, and failure modes.
Implement Realtime Event Model incrementally and predict observable evidence before execution.
Diagnose a controlled Realtime Event Model failure from evidence.
Apply Realtime Event Model to a new TaskFlow requirement without copying the reference implementation.
